fields.statement: At e4520d10 (attempt 2): go test -trimpath ./internal/web/... passes, including TestOverviewShowsMilestoneProgress, which renders / and /fragments/milestones over two milestones with change sets in accepted and proposed states and asserts the per-state pills and counts (3, 2), the change set totals and href=/roadmap, plus the empty state.
